entries.claim: For m independent tests each at level alpha, the familywise error rate is 1 - (1 - alpha)^m
entries.notes: Assumes independence; correlated tests give a lower FWER

entries.claim: Bonferroni correction compares each p-value to alpha/m, controlling the familywise error rate without an independence assumption
The Benjamini-Hochberg procedure controls the false discovery rate by rejecting the largest k with p_(k) <= (k/m) q
entries.notes: Guarantees FDR <= q under independence or positive dependence

entries.claim: Berkeley 1973 graduate admissions showed a higher overall male admission rate, but most departments showed little or no bias against women; the gap was driven by differing application choices
Abraham Wald argued for armouring the parts with the fewest returning-aircraft hits, because aircraft hit there did not return
entries.notes: Historical reconstruction of Wald's WWII work

entries.claim: With about a million comparisons, a Bonferroni threshold is of order 0.05/10^6 = 5e-8
entries.notes: Direct arithmetic from alpha/m, not a specific study value

entries.claim: The FWER curve is computed exactly; the Simpson figure uses constructed teaching data that reverses under aggregation
entries.notes: Figure 2 numbers are synthetic, not the Berkeley data
